newsitem.title: USA: S.O.I. Industries changes name, symbol.
newsitem.headline: S.O.I. Industries changes name, symbol.

text.p: S.O.I. Industries Inc said Friday its shareholders had approved a name change to Millennia Inc IA.A and said its shares on the American Stock Exchange will trade under the new symbol "IA."
The company said the name and symbol changes will be effective Monday, December 16.
In November the company said it had dismissed S.W. Hatfield & Associates as its accountants and hired Hein & Associates LLP.
S.O.I. Industries reported a fiscal 1996 loss of $5.4 million, or $3.14 per share.
